subject: Aurelia Financial — private deployment evaluation & rollout plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@aurelia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Aurelia Financial — private deployment evaluation & rollout plan

Jordan — thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to kick off a short mutual action / evaluation plan so both sides have clear owners, success criteria, and a near-term close timeline for a private (VPC/on-prem) deployment.

Quick summary of what we need to align on at kickoff:
- Primary owners (Aurelia & Redwood) for networking/VPN and IAM/KMS
- Deployment topology (single VPC vs multi-region, on-prem gateway if relevant)
- Evaluation criteria (latency SLA targets, throughput targets, data residency constraints, security attestations)
- Timeline to production-ready evaluation (PoC window, contract milestones, procurement checkpoints)

I've attached a short MAP template (Aurelia_MAP_Template.xlsx) that we typically use — please fill the owner columns where convenient. Proposed kickoff slots next week (PT):
- Tue Jan 26, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jan 27, 15:00–15:45

Can you confirm your internal stakeholders (network, security/KMS, legal for NDA, and SRE) and which slot works? On our side: Marissa will lead the technical onboarding, Sean will cover deployment topology and perf targets, Vivek (security) will own KMS/HSM questions, and Monica will handle the initial infra proofs.

Goal for the MAP: agree on evaluation success criteria and a 6–8 week PoC cadence that feeds into procurement/contract sign.

Thanks — happy to call out any missing pieces in the template.

— Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_Template.xlsx
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@aurelia.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team <ops@aurelia.com>, Aurelia Legal <legal@aurelia.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurelia Financial — private deployment evaluation & rollout plan

Aditya — thanks for pulling this together and for the template. Quick answers from our side:
- Networking/VPN owner: Jordan Ellis (me, will coordinate with our network lead)
- IAM/KMS owner: Priya Saha (Dir, Security Engineering) — I looped legal and ops in CC; Priya will reply separately with details on KMS/HSM preferences (managed KMS vs customer HSM)
- SRE/Infra contact: Luis Mendez (luis.mendez@aurelia.com)
- Legal: see CC for NDA review — we can bump the NDA sign quick.

Preferred kickoff: Wed Jan 27, 15:00 PT works best. I attached our RFP excerpt that lists our evaluation checklist and residency requirements. A couple clarifying Qs before kickoff:
1) For the PoC, do you require a dedicated GPU pool or can we run a constrained test on shared capacity?
2) Do you have a recommended low-latency topology for a single-region vs multi-region eval?

I'll have Priya send KMS preferences and Luis confirm network details by Monday.

— Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Principal Cloud Architect, Aurelia Financial
jordan.ellis@aurelia.com | +1 (212) 555-9876

Attachments: Aurelia_RFP.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@aurelia.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurelia Financial — private deployment evaluation & rollout plan

Looping in the Redwood technical owners so roles are explicit before kickoff.
- Networking/VPN & topology: Sean Gallagher (sean_gallagher@redwood.com) — will propose topology sketches and VPN options (IPSec vs AWS Direct Connect / partner transit).
- KMS & security attestations: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com) — will bring our KMS/HSM integration practices, and a list of SOC/ISO artifacts we can share under NDA.
- PoC infra & provisioning: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) — will own cloud provisioning templates and quick-start infra.
- CS & rollout contact: Tessa Morgan (tessa_morgan@redwood.com) — will coordinate acceptance testing and runbooks post-PoC.

Aditya — when we meet I can run through three topology options with rough perf/cost tradeoffs and a network checklist (NAT, egress, firewall rules). Jordan — thanks for the RFP; we can pre-populate parts of the MAP template based on that.

— Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Note: I attached a small topology sketch for discussion (networking-topology-sketch.png)

Subject: Re: Aurelia Financial — private deployment evaluation & rollout plan

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming kickoff: Wed Jan 27, 2027, 15:00–15:45 PT (calendar invite to follow). Agenda (30 min + 15 Q/A):
1) Introductions + owner roll call (5 min)
2) Topology options and recommended PoC footprint (10 min)
3) KMS + compliance artifacts needed for access (8 min)
4) MAP milestones & timeline to sign (7 min)

Action items before kickoff (owners):
- Aurelia: confirm Priya Saha and Luis Mendez availability; legal to review NDA (Jordan / legal) — due Mon Jan 25.
- Redwood: Marissa to circulate topology options and a pre-filled MAP sheet; Vivek to list required security artifacts; Monica to prepare provisioning checklist.
- Both: review attached MAP template and the RFP excerpt; add any missing acceptance criteria to the template.

I'll upload the template to the shared HubSpot record and add the kickoff minutes/notes after the call. If anything changes on timing, please ping me.

All set — kickoff went great and Priya confirmed KMS preferences (BYOK with customer HSM for production; managed KMS acceptable for PoC). Luis confirmed network contacts and we'll provide an edge IP range by EOD. Legal has signed the NDA and attached the signed stub.

Next steps I recorded in our side of the MAP: PoC start Feb 7, 2-week baseline evaluation, then performance tuning week, with a target sign decision by Mar 4 if PoC acceptance criteria are met.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session notes.

— Jordan
